text:
Sam (Finance): FYI BridgeCost sent a renewal with a 19% increase and a new 'data-processing' line. Can procurement evaluate alternatives and confirm the invoice lines?

Riley (Procurement): Put a hold on signing. I'll request an itemized justification from BridgeCost and ask for a migration credit. Two candidates for comparison: LedgerMate and CostPilot. Need our last 9 months usage by sku to model TCO.

Dev (SRE): Integration note: BridgeCost currently streams hourly NDJSON to our S3 and we run nightly reconciles. Risk switching is schema mismatch and replaying historic files. I can do a schema diff if we get a sample export from alternatives.

Ana (Platform): BridgeCost also enforces tokenization tiers in their billing. If LedgerMate charges per-processed-unit we might save on off-peak. But need precise event definitions. Can someone export event-level counts?

Marta (Legal): Before sharing any usage with LedgerMate/CostPilot, confirm they've signed our NDA and provide SOC2 Type II and DPA. Also request subprocessors list and data retention policy.

Riley (Procurement): I'll draft a short RFP: base fee, per-unit, burst pricing, egress, onboarding/migration credits, SLA credits, backfill support, and sample export schema. Will push to all three under NDA.

Sam (Finance): Action: can Billing export month-by-month totals (tokens/events/bytes) for last 9 months by sku? We want committed-usage numbers to negotiate.

Dev (SRE): I'll run the query and sanitize PII. Sample I'll post:

```
sku,month,tokens,events,bytes
billing_tokens,2024-10,987654,12000,234567890
realtime_events,2024-10,54321,67890,12345678
```

Dev (SRE): ETA full export: 3h.

vendor-bot: BridgeCost uploaded renewal_notice_1780054400.pdf and invoice_1780054410.pdf. Renewal summary: list $37,800/mo -> proposed $45,000/mo; new line: data_processing_fee=0.0025/unit.

Riley (Procurement): Nice catch on the data_processing_fee. I'll ask for 20% off list and a 6-month migration credit. If BridgeCost won't negotiate, pilot LedgerMate for 30 days on a subset.

Ana (Platform): LedgerMate claims delta webhooks and Parquet exports; CostPilot claims full historical replay support but charges for backfills. Include backfill pricing in RFP.

Marta (Legal): I'll prep the NDA + DPA template and send to Procurement to attach to the RFP. Also require breach notification within 48 hours and encryption-at-rest details.

Sam (Finance): Good. Next steps: Dev uploads sanitized usage (ETA 3h), Riley sends RFP under NDA (ETA 48h), Marta circulates legal checklist. Reconvene when vendor replies. /remind me in 4 days to review responses.
